VisiMisi.title: Vision & Mission
VisiMisi.subtitle: The foundation and direction of the BEM STMIK Tazkia Cabinet in bringing positive change to the STMIK Tazkia academic community.
VisiMisi.visiText: To establish BEM STMIK Tazkia as an initiator of progressive, inclusive, and impactful movements for the academic community and society based on information technology.
VisiMisi.misi0: Optimize responsive and solution-oriented student advocacy services.
VisiMisi.misi1: Build a space for critical and innovative intellectual dialogue in technology.
VisiMisi.misi2: Align student movements with strategic national digitalization issues.
